State of each tab

Source: R/tabs.R
kit_tab_states.Rd

Works out how each tab looks from the state of its status box (the state of kit_status()):

Usage

kit_tab_states(
  status,
  locked = character(0),
  locked_tips = NULL,
  tabset = "tabs"
)

Arguments

status

A named list or character vector: names are tab values, values are states. Tabs not listed are left unchanged.

locked

Tabs that cannot be used yet: a character vector of values, or a named logical.

locked_tips

The hover text for tabs that cannot be used yet: one string (the same for all), or a character vector named by value.

tabset

The tabset id (tabsetPanel(id = )).

Value

A list with one list(tabset, value, state, tip) per tab.

Details

  • "locked" (gray): tabs listed in locked. The hover text is locked_tips.

  • "done" (with ✓): the state is "success" or "warning" (or directly "done").

  • "stale" (✓ removed): the state is "stale".

  • "ready": anything else ("idle", "error", "ready").

Pass the result to kit_send_tab_states() (or kit_watch_tab_states()) to send it to the browser.

Examples

kit_tab_states(
  list(upload = "success", missing = "stale", join = "idle"),
  locked = "join", locked_tips = c(join = "還不能用：先加入至少 2 個檔案")
)
#> [[1]]
#> [[1]]$tabset
#> [1] "tabs"
#> 
#> [[1]]$value
#> [1] "upload"
#> 
#> [[1]]$state
#> [1] "done"
#> 
#> [[1]]$tip
#> [1] "已完成"
#> 
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [[2]]$tabset
#> [1] "tabs"
#> 
#> [[2]]$value
#> [1] "missing"
#> 
#> [[2]]$state
#> [1] "stale"
#> 
#> [[2]]$tip
#> [1] "設定或檔案改過了：要重新執行"
#> 
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [[3]]$tabset
#> [1] "tabs"
#> 
#> [[3]]$value
#> [1] "join"
#> 
#> [[3]]$state
#> [1] "locked"
#> 
#> [[3]]$tip
#> [1] "還不能用：先加入至少 2 個檔案"
#>
